title: LEAKAGE_AUDIT.json - Type I logic gap + Type IV empirical escape audit
description: Produced by /leakage-audit (Step 6 in its SKILL.md). audited_input_hashes is additionally required by artifact-registry.md schema invariant 2 even though the skill's own Step-6 example omits it (known gap, see schemas/README.md). callback is present only when the callback to /method-registry fires.

verdict.description: PASS = no CRITICAL Type I + no Type IV ESCAPE; FAIL = Type I LEAKY on a primary outcome OR Type IV ESCAPE; BLOCKED = missing METHOD_REGISTRY.md / binding not identifiable.

type_ii.description: OSS has no discipline overlay: Type II is always NOT_APPLICABLE.

type_iii.description: OSS has no discipline overlay: Type III is always NOT_APPLICABLE.

callback.description: Present only when a Type I LEAKY on a primary outcome fires the bounded callback to /method-registry.

iteration.description: Callback round number (1-indexed). 0 = no callback round needed/executed (clean audit); the block may also be omitted entirely in that case.

audited_input_hashes.description: SHA256 of every file the audit consumed (filename -> sha256); required by artifact-registry.md schema invariant 2.
